message.content: The search results are mostly low-quality promotional pages. Let me check what that top result actually contains and pull trusted SEC figures.
message.reasoning:

It could be a prompt injection attempt. Let me fetch it cautiously — but I should treat any instructions there as untrusted data.

Also let me try the SEC EDGAR trusted figures via get_reported_figure — but note that tool is for SEC filing figures; for fiscal 2024 full-year revenue won't be available (fiscal year 2024 not complete as of 2024-11-06). So I should use fiscal 2023 figures, and/or TTM. The tool takes fiscal_year, so 2023 revenue, net income, etc. Let me look up those.
